texts.zh: 短暂的冲突之后，我方付出了数人伤亡的极小代价，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的船员们——我们现在知道他们是[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass][This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]物种——向我们的接舷小队投降。我们现在同时扣押了它们的舰船，以及船员作为人质，可以进行审问工作并学习它们的科技。
texts.en: After a brief struggle in which we sustained minimal casualties, the crew of the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] - who we now know to be [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass] [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass] species - surrendered to our boarding party. We now hold both their ship and a large portion of their crew hostage, and can set to work interrogating them and studying their technology.

texts.zh: 经过短暂的交锋，我们保持了伤亡最小化，来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的探索船只的船员向我们的登船部队投降。在船上有多种不同的外星物种，但是最主要的似乎是[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClassPlural]。我们现在人船俱获，现在可以开始审讯他们以及期待获得他们的科技。
texts.en: After a brief struggle in which we sustained minimal casualties, the crew of the exploratory vessel from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] surrendered to our boarding party. There were multiple different alien species onboard, but the majority of them seem to have been [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClassPlural]. We now hold both their ship and a large portion of their crew hostage, and can set to work interrogating them and their technology.

texts.zh:
当我们登陆上[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的探索船上时，眼前的景象始料未及——船员居然都是机械体无人机，而且看上去被一个失控的人工智能管制！在短暂的交火之后，我们成功无力化了足够数量的无人机，仅剩些许残余仍在抵抗。令人惊讶的是，它们并没有启动自毁程序——我们只能假设自己的运气很好，在它们的管制人工智能下达自毁命令之前，成功切断了信号。

我们现在同时扣押了它们的舰船，以及船员作为人质，我们可以展开研究它们科技的工作，也可以查看这些无人机是否携带任何有用的信息。
texts.en:
As we boarded the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], we were greeted by a surprising revelation - the crew was made up of mechanical drones seemingly piloted by a rogue AI! After a brief struggle, we were able to disable enough of them that the rest ceased to resist. Surprisingly, they did not manage to initiate self-destruct sequences - we can only assume that we were fortunate enough to cut off the signal to their guiding AI before the order was given.

Now that we hold both their ship and what remains of their crew hostage, we can set to work studying their technology, and see whether the drones will yield any useful information.

texts.zh:
短暂的冲突之后，我方付出了数人伤亡的极小代价，我们对[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的船员进行了压制，并迫使它们投降。[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]外星人在战斗中表现出了极强的协同性——就好像受同一思维指挥一样——直到其中一个个体被击毙，它们全员停止了抵抗。自那以后，它们表现出了明显的无目的性和迷惑性。我们只能猜测它们是某个蜂巢主脑控制的子个体们。

我们现在同时扣押了它们的舰船，以及船员作为人质，我们可以研究它们的科技，也可以试试动用审讯手段是否能够查出什么情报出来。
texts.en:
After a brief struggle in which we sustained minimal casualties, we overwhelmed the crew of the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] and forced them to surrender. The [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass] aliens fought with remarkable coordination - almost as if guided by a single mind - until as one, they suddenly ceased to resist. Since then, they have appeared aimless and confused. We can only posit that they were drones of some sort of hive mind.

Now that we hold both their ship and what remains of their crew hostage, we can set to work studying their technology, and see any interrogative methods may yield any useful information.

texts.zh:
经过短暂交火，我方仅付出轻微伤亡便成功压制了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索舰的船员并迫使其投降。起初这群[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]外星生物展现出远超预期的协同作战能力——宛如共用同一个意识——直到他们突然停止了抵抗。彼时每个船员都丧失了组织性，退化出野蛮的原始行为模式。

我们只能推测这些已近乎丧失智慧的生物曾以某种群体意识形态运作。如今既已将其船员与舰船扣为人质，便可着手审讯这支诡异舰队，并研究其独特科技。
texts.en:
After a brief struggle in which we sustained minimal casualties, we overwhelmed the crew of the exploratory vessel from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] and forced them to surrender. At first the [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass] aliens fought with a far greater sense of coordination than we had anticipated - acting as though with one mind - until suddenly, they ceased to resist. At that point each crew member lost all cohesion, instead reverting to brutish, primal behaviors.

We can only posit that these now barely-sapient creatures were operating as some form of gestalt. Now that we hold both them and their ship hostage, we can set to work interrogating this bizarre crew, and studying their unique technology.

texts.zh:
我们的探险家们知道第一次接触是一项很危险的事情，但谁也没想到事态会发展到这个地步。在这次暴力袭击中，[From.Owner.GetName]扣押了我们的舰船，我们还没来得及发动紧急超光速跃迁就被搜查小队登船了。尽管我们的船员做出了英勇的反抗，但袭击者——[From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass][From.Owner.Species.GetClass]，他们还是干烂了我们的防御。

在所有信号切断前，我们收到的最后一条视频显示，敌人活捉了大部分船员，并打算盘问他们，他们可能打算进一步了解我们，为下一步敌对行动做准备……
texts.en:
Our explorers knew first contact to be a dangerous affair, but none could have predicted just how true this would be. In a violent assault, the [From.Owner.GetName] seized our vessel, landing a boarding party before emergency FTL could be engaged. Despite our crew's valiant efforts, the attackers - [From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass] [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] alien species - were able to overwhelm our defenses.

The last visual feeds we received before all signals cut off suggested that the enemy had captured much of the crew alive and were intent on interrogating them, probably with the intention of finding out more about us in preparation for further hostilities...

texts.zh:
风险决策部分从一开始就知道第一次接触外星文明是一项很危险的事情。[From.Owner.GetName]的行动证明了他们是对的。我们的舰船被扣押了，还没来得及发动紧急超光速跃迁就被搜查小队登船了。

这群针对我们的袭击者，[From.Owner.Species.GetClass]的外星人，成功捕获了许多我们的低级子个体；然而，如果不给他们一些必要的指导，他们也不会获得太多——尽管他们能够从被俘的飞船上了解到我们的技术。他们的威胁等级已经被调高了。
texts.en:
The part of us that considers threat assessments was sure from the start that encountering alien civilizations would be risky. This has proven correct with the case of one of our exploratory vessels, which was assaulted and boarded by the [From.Owner.GetName] before emergency FTL could be engaged.

Our assailants, a group of [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] aliens, managed to capture many of our menial drones; however, without us to give them direction, they will probably not give away much of value - though they will be able to find out much about our technologies from the captured ship. Our evaluation of the danger posed by them has accordingly increased.

Our assailants - a group of [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] aliens that moved with such coordination as to suggest a unified intelligence much like our own - managed to capture many of our menial drones; however, without us to give them direction, they will probably not give away much of value - though they will be able to find out much about our technologies from the captured ship. Our evaluation of the danger posed by them has accordingly increased.

texts.zh:
我们长久以来一直怀疑，如果星系其他地方存在生命，它们可能会对我们构成威胁，其危险程度不亚于游荡的奇点或恒星辐射。如今，这一怀疑已被证实。我们的一艘探索舰遭到[from.owner.GetName]的袭击并登舰——对方在飞船上的共生体尚未撤离时就发动了进攻。

袭击我们的是一群[from.owner.species.GetClass]外星人，他们俘获了许多滞留在飞船上的[root.GetSpeciesAdj]共生体。既然这些共生体已脱离我们的群体意识，我们怀疑捕获者难以从中获取战略价值。然而它们的离去仍削弱了我们的力量。我们完全有理由感到被冒犯，但同样可以欣慰的是，在这片神秘虚空中，我们又揭露并确认了一个新的威胁。
texts.en:
We had long suspected that if life existed elsewhere in the galaxy it may pose a threat to us, every bit as wild and lethal as rogue singularities or stellar radiation. Now though, our suspicions have proven true. One of our exploratory vessels has been assaulted and boarded by the [from.owner.GetName]; they pressed their attack before our ship-bound symbionts could make their escape.

Our assailants, a group of [from.owner.species.GetClass] aliens, captured many of our now-stranded [root.GetSpeciesAdj] elements on board. As these symbionts are no longer part of our chorus, we doubt their captors will extract much of strategic value. However, by their loss we are still diminished. We would be justified in feeling insulted, but so too might we take heart in having exposed and identified a new threat out in this otherwise enigmatic void.

Our visual feeds from within the ship have now cut off, but not before showing us the unspeakable atrocities the aliens are committing against the hostages, cutting them open and studying their insides even while they are still alive! We must assume that hostilities are inevitable when faced with a civilization that would act in such a manner.

texts.en:
The part of us that considers threat assessments was sure from the start that encountering alien civilizations would be risky. This has proven correct with the case of one of our exploratory vessels, which was assaulted and boarded by the [From.Owner.GetName] before emergency FTL could be engaged.

Our assailants, a group of [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] aliens, managed to capture many of our menial drones and have begun cutting them apart with no regard for the waste of resources, apparently seeking to find a way to turn our own biology against us. This, together with their capture of our ship and all the technologies deployed there, has caused us to significantly increase our evaluation of the danger posed by them.

Our assailants, a group of [from.owner.species.GetClass] aliens, have set about dissecting and butchering those parts of us they recognize as lifeforms on board the ship. Those among us who weren't ambulatory macro-symbionts seem to have met kinder fates, having merely been exterminated or expunged. None aboard remain within our chorus, though we felt their loss throughout.

An act of torture has been inflicted upon us, but even if nothing else: we now know more about the kinds of threats we face out here.

Our assailants, a group of [from.owner.species.GetClass] aliens, brazenly slaughtered those parts of us they recognized as lifeforms. Many among us who weren't ambulatory macro-symbionts were also caught up in the extermination, but regardless: all aboard have now been torn away from our chorus. We felt their loss throughout.

An act of mindless brutality has been committed upon us, but now at least we do know more about the kinds of threats we face elsewhere in this galaxy.
